title: Prosecutor: Sara Duterte's defense never challenged bank-record authenticity
summary: House prosecutor and spokesperson Atty. Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr. said Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense may have invoked bank-secrecy laws to block the disclosure of financial records.
